d: Short, spiky ash-brown hair with a sharp, wind-swept texture frames a youthful, teenage face with narrow, focused golden-yellow eyes. The build is slender and lean, dressed in a white high-collared tunic with green accents, a flowing white cape with green lining, matching white trousers, and dark teal boots. Signature details include a gold necklace, dark fingerless gloves, and a large floating open book with a white cover and silver metallic edges.
